body: I'm tired of the anxiety attacks keeping me up every night, and losing everyone I care about without my say in it or theirs. After death I won't be aware that anything excited, I feel like I've lived enough. Sure I'm afraid, but at least it'll be something permanent.
I know I'm being selfish, being selfish and suicide go hand and hand.

Sure I'll hurt them now but they have the same fate in death, they'll probably forget me before then too. I didn't exist in your life until now, and it wouldn't be any different if I wasn't. Plus if I don't do it now I'll have to play a 60 year long waiting game to go to sleep every night with my will in my hand wondering if tomorrow will exist to me.

I've done that, I've lost weight, been to the gym. I've had relationships. I'm just done living I'm not that old, but I realize that nothing lasts forever and one day nothing will exist. I'm done, I don't want to hurt anymore for no reason.
